systems.country_label: Système Intégré d'Information des Dotations CSB (SII-CSB)
systems.owner: the State, announced by PREA (Présidence); regional health directorates (DRSP) and the Treasury as users
systems.tiers: user training launched 18 February 2026 at Fianarantsoa for Fitovinany, Haute Matsiatra and Menabe; further sessions to cover the whole territory

note: SII-CSB tracks the funds allocated to basic health centres (financial monitoring and control), not patients treated or a patient record; classed single-function on that description, so no fact.
